items.title: For AI devs and AI startups
items.raw_excerpt:
Running several projects that collectively hit $2k+/mo in API costs across OpenAI, Anthropic,& AWS Bedrock. Started doing monthly audits then found I was overspending by about 60%. Biggest wins so far: Model routing cut costs 55% with no quality loss on final output Prompt compression saved 70% on my most called endpoint Request deduplication on retries eliminated 15% of wasted calls Caching semantically similar queries knocked out another 20-30%
But I feel like I'm still missing things, especially on the infrastructure side (GPU instance sizing, spot vs. on-demand, etc). So what tools or approaches are others using? Is anyone doing this systematically or is everyone just eyeballing their dashboards? Let me know!

items.title: 53.5%市占率背后：中国自动驾驶仿真赛道的头部格局正在形成
items.raw_excerpt: L3自动驾驶进入量产周期，一个长期被低估的技术环节，正在迅速成为行业的核心基础设施——仿真。 过去几年，自动驾驶公司普遍依赖真实路测进行算法验证。但随着智能驾驶系统复杂度持续上升，这种方式逐渐暴露出明显瓶颈：   路测成本极高   极端长尾场景难以覆盖   验证周期越来越长 尤其是在端到端智能驾驶逐渐成为行业主流路线之后，系统需要面对的场景复杂度呈指数级增长。仅依靠真实世界测试，已经很难满足研发效率和安全验证的需求。 在这样的背景下，高保真仿真环境正在成为自动驾驶研发体系中的核心环节。 弗若斯特沙利文最新发布的《2026年中国物理AI仿真及数据平台研究报告》显示，中国自动驾驶仿真市场已经进入快速发展阶段。报告数据显示，在中国端到端高阶智驾仿真及数据平台市场中，51Sim以53.5%的市场份额位居第一，市场集中度开始明显提升。这也意味着，在这个技术门槛极高的细分赛道中，行业头部格局已经开始逐渐清晰。 从“测试工具”到“物理AI基础设施” 自动驾驶仿真的价值正在发生变化。 在早期阶段，仿真主要被用作算法验证工具，用于辅助开发团队进行功能测试。但随着自动驾驶系统规模不断扩大，仿真的角色已经逐渐升级。 在端到端模型和世界模型技术框架下，自动驾驶系统的研发越来越依赖 数据驱动训练 + 大规模仿真验证 的模式。 换句话说，仿真不再只是测试工具，而是逐渐成为：连接真实世界数据、算法训练与系统验证的核心基础设施。 这种变化背后，本质上是自动驾驶技术正在进入 Physical AI（物理AI）阶段。 与传统软件AI不同，Physical AI系统需要在真实物理环境中完成感知、决策与执行。自动驾驶车辆、具身智能机器人、工业自动化设备，都属于这一范畴。 而仿真环境，则成为这些系统在进入真实世界之前完成训练和验证的重要“试验场”。 技术门槛：高保真仿真并不容易 从技术

Level 3 autonomous driving has entered the mass production cycle, and simulation—a long-underestimated technical aspect—is rapidly becoming a core industry infrastructure. In recent years, autonomous driving companies have largely relied on real-world road testing for algorithm validation. However, as the complexity of intelligent driving systems continues to rise, this approach has increasingly revealed significant bottlenecks: extremely high road testing costs, difficulty in covering extreme long-tail scenarios, and increasingly lengthy validation cycles. Particularly with end-to-end intelligent driving gradually becoming the mainstream industry approach, the complexity of scenarios the system must handle has grown exponentially. Relying solely on real-world testing can no longer adequately meet the demands of R&D efficiency and safety validation.

Against this backdrop, high-fidelity simulation environments are becoming a core component of the autonomous driving R&D system. According to Frost & Sullivan's latest "2026 China Physical AI Simulation and Data Platform Research Report," China's autonomous driving simulation market has entered a phase of rapid development. The report indicates that in China's end-to-end high-level intelligent driving simulation and data platform market, 51Sim holds the top position with a 53.5% market share, and market concentration is beginning to increase significantly. This also means that in this highly technical niche segment, the leading industry landscape is gradually becoming clear.

En los últimos años, las empresas de conducción autónoma han dependido principalmente de pruebas en carretera reales para validar algoritmos. Sin embargo, a medida que la complejidad de los sistemas de conducción inteligente sigue aumentando, este enfoque ha revelado cuellos de botella evidentes: costos extremadamente altos de pruebas en carretera, dificultad para cubrir escenarios extremos de larga cola y ciclos de validación cada vez más prolongados. Especialmente ahora que la conducción inteligente de extremo a extremo se está convirtiendo en la tendencia principal de la industria, la complejidad de los escenarios que el sistema debe enfrentar crece exponencialmente. Confiar únicamente en pruebas del mundo real ya no puede satisfacer las necesidades de eficiencia en investigación y desarrollo ni de validación de seguridad.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 作者 | 吴优 编辑 | 余快 2026 年开年，AI 圈的核心战场，正悄然从大模型算力比拼，转向能真正落地执行的 AI 智能体。OpenClaw（业内昵称「龙虾」）凭借颇具颠覆性的体验持续升温，热度超过了基础大模型。 这款开源 AI 数字员工框架，被业内形象地比作一位全天候主动型「超级实习生」—— 与 ChatGPT、Claude「问一句、动一下」的被动应答模式不同，OpenClaw 理论上可 24 小时在线主动推进任务：查收邮件、管理日程、操控硬件、自动写代码、定时提醒，甚至在用户休眠时后台执行操作。短短数月，其 GitHub 星标突破数十万，成为全球增长最快的开源 AI 项目之一，但这一热度能否持续转化为产业价值，目前尚无定论。 在创新之都深圳，OpenClaw 主题活动一周内接连举办数场。3 月 6 日，全球首场 OpenClaw×AI 硬件千人闭门聚会落地，仅用 3 天筹备就吸引超 1200 人报名，400 余人到场，现场座无虚席，还获得了 OpenClaw 创始人的亲自点赞。这场由 AGI-X、Kickstarter、INNO100 联合主办的盛会，全程聚焦实战落地，或可为 AI 硬件的未来走向，提供一份鲜活的观察样本。 千人「养虾」盛会：AI 从云端对话，试探着走进物理世界 这场聚会，更像是 AI 硬件圈的一场「龙虾实战嘉年华」。参会者覆盖硬件创业者、开发者、投资人、大厂高管与海外从业者，现场鲜有空泛的概念宣讲，多为 OpenClaw 与硬件结合的初步探索方案。 活动流程紧凑且干货密集：AMD 大中华区市场营销副总裁昝仲阳现场展示了适配 OpenClaw 的本地算力硬件；柒柒爱学习主理人詹琦分享了零基础玩转 OpenClaw 的实战经验；圆桌论坛直击 Token 成本、本地部署等核心痛点；最后的 Demo 竞赛堪称高潮，10 个基于 OpenClaw 的硬件项

Author | Wu You  Editor | Yu Kuai  At the beginning of 2026, the core battleground in the AI sphere is quietly shifting from the competition in large model computing power to AI agents that can truly be implemented. OpenClaw (nicknamed "Lobster" in the industry) continues to gain momentum with its disruptive experience, surpassing the popularity of foundational large models.  
This open-source AI digital employee framework is vividly compared by the industry to an all-weather proactive "super intern"—unlike the passive response mode of ChatGPT and Claude, which require a prompt for every action, OpenClaw can theoretically operate 24/7 to proactively advance tasks: checking emails, managing schedules, controlling hardware, writing code automatically, setting reminders, and even performing operations in the background while the user sleeps. In just a few months, its GitHub stars have exceeded hundreds of thousands, making it one of the fastest-growing open-source AI projects globally. However, whether this popularity can be sustainably translated into industrial value remains uncertain.

The venue was packed, and the event even received personal praise from the founder of OpenClaw. excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, the emerging AI hardware technology company Weiguang Dianliang completed a Pre-A round of financing exceeding 100 million RMB. This round was jointly led by Sequoia China and BlueRun Ventures, with participation from Ant Strategic Investment, CDH Investments, and An Yu Capital, while existing shareholder Jiuhe Venture Capital continued to follow on. The raised funds will primarily be used for building a core talent team, developing new intelligent hardware, training vertical models, and implementing key application scenarios for fashion Agents, aiming to establish an integrated AI-native product innovation system of "hardware + model + scenario" to accelerate the scenario-based commercialization of fashion AI hardware.

Weiguang Dianliang's founder, Song Ziwei, graduated from Shanghai University with a degree in Applied Physics and previously held key product roles at renowned companies such as Huawei, vivo, and Li Auto. As an early founding member of vivo's iQOO brand, she led the definition, development, and launch of multiple hit product series from scratch, contributing to the rapid growth of the iQOO brand.

The core team at Weiguang Dianliang largely hails from leading technology companies, with most members having hands-on experience in consumer hardware projects reaching tens of millions of users. The company's Chief Technology Officer is Xiao Fangxu, former core executive of vivo's AI division, who has long been dedicated to on-device AI technology and large model applications. The Chief Design Officer is a former senior design director at BMW and vivo. Core team members also include seasoned experts from well-known tech companies such as Li Auto, Baichuan, Insta360, and Anker.
